grid: 09:05..11:30 and12:35..15:25 JST every5 active minutes; [t−5,t) window, half-open
source: Existing saved unadjusted1m raw rows with complete minute timestamp and positive finite Close, same symbol/session; chronological latest row in the current closed5m window
mark: Close of that latest saved bar, not a synthetic bar and not a missing-price imputation
known_at: Bar assumed available after its minute completes; chosen minute+1<=grid t; publish at grid t. Actual historical receipt UNKNOWN; research-reference contract, no live certification.
empty_window: POSITION_MEASUREMENT_BLOCKED / MISSING_FUNDED_WINDOW_MTM_MARK; stop this arm, preserve all candidates and only known-prefix records; full metrics null
source_conflict: Fail-closed on duplicate minute with different OHLC values; don't choose favourable price
future_fields: Minute >=t, next window, High/Low, future EXIT PnL, future execution status do not determine current mark or BUY rank
event_order: Scheduled valid source-completion cash release -> current closed-window marks for still-open funded positions -> same-time Entry allocation -> frame
